gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (cash basis governmental funds) Total receipts 12,676,868 = General 8,467,693 + Street Department 1,824,114 + Economic Development 597,750 + Recreational Agency 987,863 + Debt Service 679,505 + Community Development Agency 119,943. detail[] = budget schedules General p8 (8,460,779), Street p9 (1,824,114), Economic Development p10 (597,750) = 10,882,643. Missing fund columns (no schedule): Recreational Agency Fund Taxes 987,863; Debt Service Fund Taxes 645,209 + State revenue 34,296 = 679,505; Community Development Agency Fund TIF project property taxes 40,508 + Charges for services 78,757 + Investment income 678 = 119,943. Missing line: the General Fund budget schedule leaves out the statement's General column 'TIF project property taxes' 6,914 (8,467,693 - 8,460,779 = 6,914). 10,882,643 + 987,863 + 679,505 + 119,943 + 6,914 = 12,676,868 = statement_total. Taxes in the Recreational Agency and Debt Service columns are not broken down by type anywhere in the trim (the p2 split is for the Total only), so category taxes. The Debt Service column's other-financing 'Debt issuance' 4,065,962 is also added (section other financing; it does not enter the revenue sum).
